source_ref: AICTE Approval Process Handbook (APH) 2024-27 Chapter IV

rules.description: Submission of sworn affidavit on prescribed stamp paper is mandatory for Extension of Approval.
NOC from State Government / Affiliating University is mandatory for continuing courses.
Proof of barrier-free campus land compliance and infrastructure certification.
State/University NOC validity must extend across the academic year 2026-27.
Affidavit execution date must be within 180 days of the EoA application filing.
Legal institution name must be identical across all submitted documents and AICTE master records.
Total claimed intake must not exceed the sanctioned intake recorded in the AICTE national registry.
Technical Education Regulatory (TER) fee payment status must be fully settled and confirmed.
